sn41.5:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā kāmabhū macchikasaṇḍe viharati ambāṭakavane.
sn41.5:1.2: atha kho citto gahapati yenāyasmā kāmabhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ kāmabhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cittaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā kāmabhū etadavoca
sn41.5:4.1: imassa nu kho gahapati saṅkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti.
sn41.5:4.2: kiṃ nu kho etaṃ bhante bhagavatā bhāsitanti.
sn41.5:4.4: tenahi bhante muhuttaṃ āgamehi yāvassa atthaṃ pekkhāmīti.
sn41.5:4.5: atha kho citto gahapati muhuttaṃ tuṇhī hutvā āyasmantaṃ kāmabhuṃ etadavoca
sn41.5:5.2: setapacchādoti kho bhante vimuttiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn41.5:5.3: ekāroti kho bhante satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn41.5:5.5: rathoti kho bhante imassetaṃ cātummahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsupacayassa aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammassa.
sn41.5:5.6: rāgo kho bhante nīgho doso nīgho moho nīgho
sn41.5:5.7: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅgatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā
sn41.5:5.9: appattanti kho bhante arahato etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn41.5:5.11: sā khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅgatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā
sn41.5:5.13: rāgo kho bhante bandhanaṃ doso bandhanaṃ moho bandhanaṃ
sn41.5:5.14: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṅgatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā
sn41.5:5.16: iti kho bhante yantaṃ bhagavatā vuttaṃ
sn41.5:7.1: imassa khohaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn41.5:7.2: lābhā te gahapati suladdhaṃ te gahapati
sn41.5:7.3: yassa te gambhīre buddhavacane paññācakkhu kamatīti.
